name: cluster list
description: Show the OpenShift cluster this call resolves to (--env, --instance or --connection, else the default); toil connections list shows them all

name: pods
description: List pod health summary for a namespace — pre-processed for LLM analysis. Use --raw to return the full unmodified Kubernetes pod objects.

name: deployments
description: List Deployments (or OpenShift DeploymentConfigs with --deployment-configs) for a namespace, read-only. Use --raw to return the full unmodified objects.

name: events
description: List Warning events for a namespace — pre-filtered for LLM analysis

name: logs
description: Get recent log lines from a pod container

name: pod-metrics
description: Get CPU and memory usage for pods in a namespace (requires metrics-server)

name: resource-usage
description: Combined CPU/memory usage, limits, and requests for all pods in a namespace — all values normalized to millicores (m) and mebibytes (Mi). Requires metrics-server. Use --csv with --out <file> to also save a spreadsheet-friendly CSV.
